skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply numerical methods for solving equations, approximating derivatives and integrals, and simulating polynomial interpolation.
Identify and calculate various types of errors in numerical computations.
Apply polynomial interpolation techniques to approximate functions.
Use MATLAB to implement numerical methods and solve practical problems.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve complex numerical problems.
Work effectively in teams to solve numerical problems and present solutions.
Demonstrate ability to independently learn and apply new concepts and tools.
